source.title: Dragonflight named independent processing event-log and addon-export source search

notes: Fresh name-first searches targeted public per-operation export ledgers and studies rather than repeating already indexed Jallfo/ar_rules/Aary/superbondez cohorts. ProspectMate supports saved prospect/mill tracking, but the pages inspected expose no public original Dragonflight 0-N event table. Forum/Reddit/guide results offered qualitative notes, copied cohorts or nominal inputs only. No new Dragonflight ore/herb measured per-material histogram, per-operation zero count, rank-resolved castsWithDrop or refund-corrected completed-cast denominator was obtained. No guessed numeric rates have been entered.
lookingFor: T0020/T0019/T0041/T0018/T0015/T0046 independent Draconium, Serevite, Khaz'gorite, Prismatic prospecting and Bubble Poppy/Saxifrage/Hochenblume milling per-operation 0/1/2+ logs or shared ProspectMate exports
whereLooked: CurseForge ProspectMate public project description and downloadable addon, no original public player-export cohort: https://www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/prospectmate
Wago ProspectMate old expansion tracking documentation, no player event ledger: https://addons.wago.io/addons/prospectmate
Reddit r/woweconomy Draconium Ore and Serevite Ore raw prospect result search, known nominal-ore cohort not a new per-cast export: https://www.reddit.com/r/woweconomy/comments/10i63zb

Blizzard forums Illimited Diamond Draconium Ore original-results search, anecdotal 2 and 8 diamonds without exact completed casts: https://us.forums.blizzard.com/en/wow/t/illimited-diamond-where-are-you/1505082
Wowhead Bubble Poppy and Saxifrage input/output named searches, only deterministic milling identity/comments: https://www.wowhead.com/item=191469/bubble-poppy

Wowhead Saxifrage original Aary 1.7k nominal-herb report, existing cohort already indexed, not a new raw mill event log: https://www.wowhead.com/ptr-2/item=191465/saxifrage
